Source: plans_dgz.md

What this is

Plans by DGZ to improve HowMaHiCo.

Instructions: when prompted, you can read this file and provide a plan to do the pending tasks in “to do”. When something is done, move it to the end of “Done”. Do not consider the points in “In standby”, until they are moved to “to do”

To do

In standby

  • peptide position within the parent protein (the third part of the physicochemical-properties item) — deferred; it is the only part that needs a user-supplied search FASTA, since no loader carries a position column (FragPipe psm.tsv, DIA-NN report.tsv and PEAKS peptide.csv all lack one). Full design recorded in CLAUDE.md under “Deferred designs”.

  • implement safeguard when some conditions or replicates give 0 areas, currently throwing error — moved to standby (no repro available; e.g. CHEB_001 all dda dataset not in repo). The all-NA Area/CV and all-NA correlation cases are already guarded in the report chunks; the partial (some groups 0/NA) failure needs a repro to target.

  • For PTM plots, translate unimod code into modification name — deferred (full implementation design saved in memory/project_ptm_translation_plan.md). Scope chosen: translate BOTH UniMod accessions AND delta masses to names. Key gotcha: only DIA-NN stores UniMod codes (UniMod:NN); FragPipe (default/sim) and PEAKS store delta masses. Plan: new R/ptm.R with ptm_reference() + translate_ptm(), wired into plot_ptm_heatmap() as a display-time translate=TRUE arg; correct the wrong PTM note in 01_id_counts skeleton.

  • InteractivePlots (TRUE/FALSE) toggle to render compatible plots via ggplotly — deferred: most compatible plots print inside results=‘asis’ tabset loops where embedding plotly htmlwidgets (vs static ggplots) is finicky and only render-verifiable, which we don’t do in-session. Groundwork ready: plotly already in Imports + loaded in shared setup.Rmd; ggplotly already used for the correlation plots (04_quant L110/L143). Skip ggseqlogo / ggupset / ggvenn / ggarrange composites / base plot_heatmap.

  • Calculate an fdr for length distribution. What’s the probability of detecting the length distribution vs. the background proteome?

  • Total by Condition /BioReplicate / Sample in tabs

  • more explicit errors, e.g., when files are not found

  • autogenerate Sample by concatenating the others

  • bioreplicate as numbers or text, without condition, gets merged afterwards

  • maybe generate a report in long format

  • include whole folder with dia-quant-output when diann

  • check and deal with license discrepancies between howmahico, peptides, limma

  • de-vendor get_dirs_index_peaks: removed the vendored/deltaProtR provenance, renamed R/vendored-deltaprotr.R to R/loaders-peaks-dirs.R, converted its pipes to |> (v0.3.0)

  • 2do by me change purple color of length plots to a dimmer one

  • Overlap intra-Condition (across replicates), split into individual plots for each length: plot_overlap_intra_condition() refactored to single-plot (df, id_col, title); report section now All peptides / Selected peptides nested tabsets (v0.5.0)

  • Peptides identified per charge +1 to +4, one plot for all peptides (pep_all) and one for selected length (pep_short), shown in an All / Selected tabset (v0.5.0)

  • multi-report framework instead of one big report: exported build_pep_all() (parse+cache step), shared inst/rmarkdown/shared/setup.Rmd child, and four focused templates 03_id_counts / 04_overlaps / 05_lcms_qc / 06_quant rendered against the cached pep_all; 01_mhc_report kept unchanged for retrocompatibility (v0.6.0)

  • PTM profile moved from 05_lcms_qc to 03_id_counts, and extended to show all peptides (pep_all) alongside selected (pep_short) in an All/Selected tabset (v0.6.1)

  • renumbered all report templates: 01_mhc_report->00_mhc_report, 02_mhc_upsets->00_mhc_upsets, 03_id_counts->01_id_counts, 04_overlaps->02_overlaps, 05_lcms_qc->03_lcms_qc, 06_quant->04_quant (v0.7.0)

  • lcms_qc RT/1k0/m_z distribution section rewritten to a single looped results=‘asis’ chunk (config list of views x peptide sets) instead of 8 hand-written chunks (v0.7.0)

  • fixed “Duplicate chunk label ‘setup’” parse error in the focused reports: shared setup.Rmd had a fenced r-chunk example inside its leading HTML comment (knitr parses chunks even in comments -> recursive re-include); comment is now prose + regression guard test (v0.7.1)

  • focused reports gained PepAllSource param (cached / rda / build) so each can load the default cache, load an explicit .rda (PepAllFile), or self-build from raw results via build_pep_all(); default = cached = prior behavior (v0.8.0)

  • added simulated FragPipe data (inst/extdata/sim_fragpipe_dda, moved out of data/) + test-sim-fragpipe.R: build_pep_all assertion + first end-to-end render test of a focused report (v0.8.0)

  • unified parser using dictionaries with option to enter a custom entry from other software: dictionary-driven parse_unified() + read_custom_batch() + annotate_unified() + read_dictionary()/get_dictionary_template(), wired into build_pep_all(software=“custom”, dictionary=…); YAML dictionaries in inst/extdata/dictionaries (custom_template + fragpipe/diann/peaks reference); built-in loaders untouched; test-parse-unified.R round-trips against the FragPipe loader (v0.9.0)

  • immunopeptidomics sample quality score (HowDirty-inspired, inverted): R/quality-score.R (score_sample_quality + qc_metrics_by_sample + anchor_information_content + score_curve + quality_thresholds_default + calibrate_thresholds_from_qc), plot_quality_heatmap/plot_quality_composite, focused report 05_quality_score; thresholds from literature defaults or in-experiment QC samples (annotation QC column, ThresholdMode=qc_relative); non-tryptic K/R signal split into low-weight diagnostic + out-of-window scored metric; no external data/deps; test-quality-score.R covers score_curve/anchor_information_content (v0.10.0)

  • cross-class MHC1<->MHC2 contamination metric: frac_cross_class (fraction of peptides in the other class’s length window outside the current one; .cross_class_range helper; lower_better, low weight, NA for custom windows) + plot_cross_class_length per-sample length histogram with cross-class region highlighted, wired into qc_metrics_by_sample/quality_thresholds_default and the 05_quality_score report (v0.11.0)

  • Average +/- sd per BioReplicate: new section in 01_id_counts mirroring per-Condition; plot_count_mean_sd() gained group_var arg (default “Condition”, pass “BioReplicate”) (v0.12.0)

  • “Selected peptides” report headers now show the active length window (e.g. “(8 to 13 AAs)”) from shortpep_range across the focused templates (v0.12.0)

  • renamed “Proteins” ID-level headers/labels to “Parent proteins” in 01_id_counts/02_overlaps (display only; data keys + plot axis labels unchanged; counts_labels display vector added alongside counts_levels) (v0.12.0)

  • Proportion by length pulled into its own 2nd-level section in 01_id_counts with Condition/BioReplicate/Sample tabs (was nested under Total-by-Condition/Sample) (v0.12.0)

  • Overlap intra-Condition: added a percentage variant section in 02_overlaps; plot_overlap_intra_condition() gained value arg (“count” default / “percent”) (v0.12.0)

  • improve the readme: made Step 2 a bare annotation skeleton (no sample_list.xlsx needed; removed the duplicated get_annot_sampleid that also lived in Step 3, now the single optional mention); added a note under Step 3 that the annotation table controls inclusion (only listed samples are read/reported) and ordering (factor levels = CSV row order); added an “Edit these for your run” callout listing the must-change params before the Step 5 render example

  • pseudochromatogram color by density: plot_pseudochromatogram() now fills RT bars by peptide Count (continuous viridis gradient) instead of per-Condition colour, keeping the facet-per-Condition layout (v0.13.0)

  • pseudomobilogram: new plot_pseudomobilogram() (count vs invk0/1k0, configurable binwidth, default 0.2, bars coloured by count, faceted by Condition); wired into 03_lcms_qc view config (new “Pseudomobilograms” tab) and 00_mhc_report distribution section (all/selected) (v0.13.0)

  • Peptides identified per charge, add black lines on bars: plot_charge_proportions() geom_bar gained color = “black” (v0.13.0)

  • plot unclustered motifs from 7 to 25: motif length window extended to 7–25 AAs (was capped at 24); section retitled “Peptide motifs (7 to 25 AAs)” in 01_id_counts and 00_mhc_report (v0.13.0)

  • add subset suffix to all the results: shared setup.Rmd (and the two 00_* reports) derive result_prefix (= Subset, NULL when unset), passed to every write.csv_rawr()/write_input_params() and prepended to seq_by_condition.xlsx, so result filenames carry the subset (e.g. dda_all_pep_all.csv); input_params combines subset + report name to stay collision-free (v0.13.0)

  • bigger font

  • mouse MHC1 option (7 to 11 AAs): new MHCclass value MHC1_mouse; windows/palettes moved to R/report-helpers.R (mhc_length_window / mhc_class_palette / mhc_classes), replacing 3 duplicated lists in the skeletons + the copy inside .cross_class_range(); quality score follows (frac_9mer counts 8+9-mers with the “8/9-mer fraction” label and higher cut-offs, anchor scored on the dominant of the two, cross-class window from the 7-11 window) (v0.15.0)

  • safeguard in get_annot_sampleid: warns when nothing matched (showing example Source_file values from both sides) and when only some rows matched (naming the dropped ones); new keep_all = TRUE argument left-joins so no annotation row is lost (v0.15.0)

  • fixed combn(conditions, 2) aborting every report with a single Condition: new exported condition_pairs() (empty list for 1 Condition, self = TRUE for the overlap-matrix diagonal) used by the shared setup + 00_mhc_report/00_mhc_upsets/02_overlaps; guarded by an end-to-end single-Condition render test (v0.15.0)

  • test mode for combined exports: files are read in full and reduced to ~100 rows PER RUN (subsample_testmode() in R/utils-loaders.R, run column auto-detected from Run/Spectrum) instead of the first 100 lines of the file, so every run/Condition/replicate survives; wrong “first 50 lines” warning fixed (v0.15.0)

  • safeguard when all area = 0: get_mat_log2area() returns a 0 x n matrix with a warning instead of erroring in select(all_of()), and the correlation chunks of 04_quant/00_mhc_report test for the empty/all-NA case before calling cor() (which errors with ‘x’ is empty) and before computing the colour limits (v0.15.0)

  • homogenized sample annotation tables across software: canonical Sample_folder column accepted by read_annot() and mirrored into Sample_fp (verbatim) / Sample_peaks (PEAKS-normalized) so the loaders are untouched and legacy CSVs still load; get_annot_fragpipe()/get_annot_diann() emit Sample_folder and PEAKS gained get_annot_peaks() (v0.15.0)

  • advanced statistics / quantification report: new 06_quant_stats template + R/quant-stats.R engine (build_quant_matrix, filter_quant, normalize_quant, impute_quant, test_differential, test_detection, combine_quant_results, summarise_significant, permanova_condition) comparing peptide Area between Conditions with limma moderated t (Welch t fallback; limma in Suggests) + Fisher presence/absence track for condition-exclusive ligands; includes data completeness plots, normalization diagnostics, dynamic range, PCA, heatmaps with and without clustering, volcano/MA/p-value plots and significance summaries, plus an in-report “Methods & justification” section (v0.14.0)

  • data completeness plots: plot_completeness() (per unit / per feature) + plot_missing_heatmap() presence-absence map, in 06_quant_stats (v0.14.0)

  • quantitative report heatmap with and without clustering, dynamic range, volcano plots: plot_quant_heatmap(cluster = TRUE/FALSE), plot_dynamic_range(), plot_volcano()/plot_ma(), all in 06_quant_stats (v0.14.0)

  • fixed run_howmahico_report(“05_quality_score”) being unreachable (template documented but missing from the match.arg choices); 05 and 06 registered + regression guard test that every shipped template dir is offered (v0.14.0)

  • peptide physicochemical properties report: new 07_pepchem template + R/pepchem.R engine (peptide_properties, pepchem_properties, aa_composition, aa_position_frequency, pepchem_by_sample, summarise_pepchem, aggregate_pepchem, cliffs_delta, compare_pepchem, compare_aa_frequency) comparing amino-acid composition (overall / per sample / enrichment vs. the pooled composition), per-position residue frequency (dominant length + N-/C-terminal profile across all lengths) and per-peptide descriptors (GRAVY, pI, charge, MW, Boman, hydrophobic moment, instability/aliphatic index, AA class fractions) between Conditions. Descriptors are summarised per SAMPLE and then tested across samples (Kruskal-Wallis + pairwise Wilcoxon, BH, MedianDiff + Cliff’s delta), with a pooled peptide-level track reported alongside as explicitly descriptive; new plots plot_aa_composition / plot_aa_position_heatmap / plot_property_distribution / plot_property_sample_summary / plot_property_effectsize; new dependency Peptides (CRAN, Rcpp only) in Imports, justified as the canonical GRAVY implementation. Position-within-the-protein moved to standby (v0.16.0)
